project_type: Python FastAPI backend + React 19 TypeScript frontend (Vite + Tailwind)
test_framework: pytest with FastAPI TestClient (backend), vitest with @testing-library/react (frontend)
build_command: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt (backend); cd frontend && npm run build (frontend)
test_command: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v (backend); cd frontend && npm run test (frontend)
verification_instructions: 1. Run backend tests: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v. 2. Run frontend build: cd frontend && npm run build. 3. Run frontend tests: cd frontend && npm run test.
setup_instructions: 1. cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt. 2. cd frontend && npm install.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.11 and Node 22 available.
contribution_requirements: Tests must pass. In-memory dict pattern backed by persistence service. Routers use _persistence instance and _projects/_workflow_states dicts.
key_patterns: Backend: PersistenceService class in services/persistence.py provides file-based JSON CRUD. Routers import PersistenceService, create instance, load data on module import into dicts, persist on mutation. Config uses pydantic-settings BaseSettings. AI config stored in separate JSON file via ai_config.py router (load_ai_config/save_ai_config functions). Frontend: axios client in src/api/client.ts uses VITE_API_URL env var (defaults to empty string for relative URLs). CORS origins in config.py settings.
directory_structure: Root: backend/, frontend/, docs/, skills/, docker-compose.yml. Backend: app/core/config.py, app/main.py, app/models/, app/routers/, app/services/, storage/, tests/. Frontend: src/api/client.ts, src/components/, src/pages/, src/hooks/, src/types/.
